fields.description: Golf Meadow combines one to three bedroom apartments with five three bedroom townhouses in Emaar South. Floor-to-ceiling glazing and a muted palette of wood, stone and earthy tones shape the interiors. The outdoor setting brings together golf-course outlooks, poolside spaces and areas for exercise and family recreation.

overview: The leisure programme includes separate adult and children’s pools, a splash pad, padel and quieter yoga spaces. The brochure treats these facilities as part of a landscape-led residential setting. The championship golf course belongs to the wider Emaar South community; a view or nearby location does not establish a membership entitlement.
research.locationNote: Golf Meadow sits in Emaar South, in the Dubai South area near Al Maktoum International Airport. The developer’s map also positions it relative to Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai. Published journey times are estimates, not guaranteed daily commutes.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s displayed unit pricing begins at AED 3,138,888 on the research date. Its AED 1.12 million launch headline describes an earlier entry point. Confirm the selected unit’s current price and availability; the published unit count is not verified stock.
research.paymentNote: The copied launch plan has an initial 10%, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. The dates below are historical launch terms. Obtain a current agreement for any new purchase rather than assuming passed instalments still apply unchanged.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment sheet targets July 2029 for estimated construction completion. Property Finder also reports July/Q3 2029. Contractual handover and current construction status require confirmation.

facts.label: Launch composition
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 81 one bedroom, 113 two bedroom and 25 three bedroom apartments, plus five townhouses: 224 launch homes, not remaining inventory.

facts.label: Historical launch prices
facts.value: The launch sheet quoted AED 1.12 million, 1.63 million and 2.45 million for one, two and three bedroom apartments; townhouses started at AED 4.95 million.

facts.label: Townhouse and tower arrangement
facts.value: The plans show townhouses across ground and podium levels, with three bedrooms upstairs and living spaces, maid’s accommodation and storage below. The tower key section continues through residential level 15.

facts.label: Reading the area figures
facts.value: Totals include balcony or terrace space. The three bedroom Type 1A sheet prints 1,572.50 sq ft, which does not match its component sum; confirm that specific layout before relying on the measurement.
